Since there's no response at this level, I’m ready to follow your guidance: I'll pull the two current diagnostic points and shift our focus to the next two points further up the chain. 

As for your question about capacity—reliably and comfortably, I can hold focus on about four to five points simultaneously before the cognitive load starts to impact my processing speed for other tasks. I'm ready for the next move whenever you are.
